_comment: HORUS measured-route transfer test of the FROZEN v3.14.24, PRE-REGISTERED before anything is run on the evaluation lap (t4-reverse) with HORUS or any of these baselines in this harness (the t4 baseline A3/CHO replays of 2026-11-01 on finals-measured-map are the only earlier runs on that lap and used other code). No retraining, tuning or decision-rule change of the candidate. Rules from finals_preregistration_v3.json (H2) unchanged; a non-inferiority reading is added and declared here. Applied by pipeline/twin/measured_v314.py.

candidate.origin: the v3.14 confirmatory candidate (H2 PASS on twin held-out 2200..2259); trained only on synthetic twin data

data.walk: t4 G-NetTrack Pro walk, LG U+ LTE band 1, 31 Oct 2026; allowlisted derived dataset data/walktest/t4 (manifest sha256 365e4b23349dc0df0ab3e73d1210f9c239896e88b9c74215d4742391fb2c1843)
data.surface: lap-1-only calibrated mean RSRP surfaces from finals-measured-map @ 99bda6b, unchanged: primary neighbor-assumption model working/evidence/t4-replay/neighbor-assumption-model.json (sha256 c75fe2587556f0ba7b262c321028c1efbccaf3936c4b10ea41685e51775315ce); serving-only model working/evidence/t4-calibration/primary-model.json (sensitivity)
data.evaluation_lap: t4-reverse (lap 2). It received descriptive QA and A3/CHO decision replays on 2026-11-01 (not with HORUS); its positions are evaluated on a surface fitted on lap 1 only. Not a blind independent collection.
data.assumptions: data/walktest/t4-phy-assumptions.json (declared PHY: 18 MHz occupied, load 0.5, external interference -110 dBm/RE)

fading_layer: off = the calibrated mean surface (deterministic, one episode, reported only). rician / rayleigh = the twin's Doppler-correlated fading (phy.PhyModel.fading_gain, 2-branch diversity, K=6 dB for Rician) at 2.12 GHz layered on the mean surface with the listed seeds: a declared assumption, not measured.
arms: v3 = v3.14.24; deployable baselines a3_global, cho_global, cho_global_ext, cho_mse, cho_mro exactly as finals_baselines(_v3).json; a3_stock reported. Per-cell oracles are tuned per synthetic cell and are undefined on this route (no H1).

hypotheses.primary_H2_measured: Block 'primary' (t4-reverse, neighbor-assumption surface, declared PHY, rician seeds 0..59 + rayleigh seeds 0..59 = 120 paired episodes): for EVERY deployable ref the pooled paired 95% CI of utility (v3 - ref) lies above 0 and every guardrail of finals_preregistration_v3.json holds (pooled upper CI of the increase <= max(rel*|ref mean|, abs); no Holm-significant increase beyond it in either fading mode).
hypotheses.secondary_non_inferiority: Same block and guardrails; utility pooled 95% CI lower bound > -1% of the ref's pooled mean utility, for every deployable ref.

expectation_from_development.source: lap 1 (t4-forward, the surface's own lap), 20+20 seeds, working/evidence/measured-v3.14/dev/
expectation_from_development.reading: On lap 1 the frozen policy beats cho_mro and a3_global by wide margins and is slightly below cho_global (-0.031) with fewer handovers. H2 is therefore expected to FAIL against cho_global on lap 2; the non-inferiority reading is the transfer question.

reporting: Only block 'primary' carries the two hypotheses. Sensitivity blocks and the 'off' episodes are reported as observed with the same statistics, never as claims. Exactly one run of all blocks: python -m twin.measured_v314 --plan pipeline/finals_preregistration_measured_v3_14.json --out working/evidence/measured-v3.14/final. No rerun, no substitute candidate, no margin change.
limits: one handset, one operator, one route, two laps
mean RSRP surface interpolated from lap 1; neighbour identities partly assumed
fading, load, interference, SINR, HO execution and throughput are modelled, not measured
segments with <2 supported cells or <5 s are excluded; segment starts reset UE and controllers
the walker's connected/idle RRC state is not established (raw logs unavailable)
